subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the deterministic guard fixes, should the reviewed secret-bearing, publishing, scanning, and Codex action revisions be accepted as one batch?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical, but accepting grouped third-party code-execution revisions across privileged workflows requires explicit repository automation/security ownership.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Accept the reviewed revisions once all three assertions are synchronized and exact-head workflow and security checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates into smaller owner-reviewed PRs.

options.title: Defer this batch
options.body: Keep the current pins until the privileged upstream deltas can be reviewed with sufficient confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed revisions once all three assertions are synchronized and exact-head workflow and security checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to the affected performance, release-proof, and CI guard surfaces, with live engagement on this PR.
